summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Gilat Satellite Networks, an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnishing the notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 8, 2026. The notice covers standard agenda items: setting board size, re-electing directors, approving share capital increase, amending articles and compensation policy, granting equity awards, and ratifying auditors. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or delisting. The filing is purely a meeting notice with proxy instructions, and the board recommends a vote FOR all proposals. It does not constitute a special situation under the classification criteria.
